name: queryTranscripts
description: Span-index search over a caller-ordered list of session transcripts. Matching runs over semantically classified byte ranges only (user text, assistant text, inline tool args/results) in that priority order — JSON syntax, metadata lines and thinking blocks can never match. Single response; a newer query supersedes an in-flight one, which returns {superseded:true} and is discarded client-side.

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: Absolute transcript.jsonl paths to search, IN PRIORITY ORDER — the guest already caches the project/session list, so it decides relevance (active session first, then by update time) and the host never enumerates or re-sorts. Searched front-to-back so the result caps cut the least relevant tail; over 2000 entries the tail is dropped and `truncated` is set. Unreadable paths are counted in `skippedFiles`, never an error.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Search text. Literal by default; RE2 syntax when `regex` is true. Empty returns success with zero matches.

inputs.name: regex
inputs.description: Treat `query` as an RE2 pattern. An invalid pattern fails with SEARCH_BAD_PATTERN and the RE2 error text.

inputs.name: caseSensitive
inputs.description: Exact-case matching. Default false = ASCII case folding for literals, case-insensitive RE2 for regex.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.description: Total match cap across all files. Absent or <= 0 means 500; clamped to 2000. The per-file cap of 10 is fixed.

inputs.name: generation
inputs.description: Client keystroke counter, echoed back verbatim so the dialog can drop out-of-order responses. Server-side supersession is independent (engine-internal counter).
